title: promptctl's change index misses the PR merge commit for directory and glob paths when both parents added files under them
problem: test_promptctl.LastChangeIndexTest.test_lookups_without_a_git_call_match_the_per_file_call failed twice on PR #19648's prompts-ci `validate` job (2026-11-27 07:03 and 07:14 UTC) for path='prompts/' and path='prompts/runs/*.json': the index answered ' (file last changed on or before 2026-11-26, the shallow-clone edge)' while `git log -1 -- <path>` named the refs/pull/N/merge commit (dated 2026-11-27T07:09:04Z). Likely cause, not yet proven: the PR added a run record and main had added others since the merge base, so the merge's tree under prompts/runs/ differs from BOTH parents and git names the merge for the directory or glob. `--diff-merges=c` lists only files that differ from every parent, and no single file does (each new record exists in exactly one parent), so the one-pass index never sees the merge for that directory. It did not reproduce in a local depth-2 clone of a merge made right after merging main into the branch (the merge was then TREESAME to the PR head under prompts/runs/). P094 fixed a different shallow-root case.
evidence: PR #19648 prompts-ci validate job 140364039262 log: AssertionError, path='prompts/runs/*.json', index (edge, '') vs git (' (file last changed 2026-11-27)', '2026-11-27T07:09:04Z')
change: In _dir_hit/_glob_hit, when HEAD is a merge, check whether the merge differs from every parent under the path (`git diff --quiet <parent> HEAD -- <path>` for each parent, two calls only on a merge checkout) and if so answer with HEAD's sha and date; or return None (let git answer) for directory/glob paths on a merge HEAD. Add a test: a temp repo where both parents of a merge add different files under one directory, cloned at depth 2.
metric: validate failures of this test on PRs in the 14 days after the fix
